dataList.content:
<Are you okay, Heathcliff?>
<清醒了吗，希斯克利夫？>
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Basement
呼啸山庄 地下室

dataList.content:
... How are you feeling?
……感觉如何？

Like shite.
像屎一样。

And miserable.
还很痛苦。

These bodies... your wounds... I did that, didn't I?
这些尸体，还有你们身上的伤口……都是我干的吗？

Heathcliff muttered, looking around at the mutilated, mauled corpses of the researchers.
希斯克利夫看见凄惨地倒在地上的研究员们的尸体，低声喃喃道。

Strange.
真奇怪。

I thought... if I went wild, smashed everything to pieces...
这次还以为如果将一切全都砸烂……

... the weight in my heart would be lifted.
我就会痛快许多。

But no. Not this time. Not at all. This... this feels awful.
但这次却不是那样。反倒觉得特别糟糕。

How am I any different from that prick, Hindley?
我变得和亨德利那家伙，没什么区别了吧。

Full of blind hatred against everything in front of me, desiring nothin' but destruction...
只是一心想要把面前的所有东西全部砸碎……

But the worst thing is... that I wanted to be like that forever.
最可怕的是……我曾想一直保持那种状态。

Because...
要说为什么……

I couldn't bear to simply sit there and do nothing.
那只是因为，我不能忍受一味等待罢了。

<No. You're not like him.>
<你和他不一样。>

<Because you came back.>
<你啊，最终变回来了呢。>

This time, sure. But what if it happens again? Who's to say that there won't be a next time?
这次虽然变回来了，但下次呢？谁能保证我不会再变成这样呢？

Maybe Hindley, that prick, was right.
也许亨德利那家伙是对的。

I'm unsalvageable. Did I change? No. I deluded myself into believing that I did, like the dullard I am.
我从出生开始就是一个错误，自己已经改变不过是一种可笑的错觉……

This is what I do, what I am. A destroyer who brings ruin to everything until there isn't anything left to pulverise.
像这样勃然大怒，不把一切破坏殆尽誓不罢休，才是我真正的模样。

<If it happens again... I can't guarantee that I'll succeed, but I will try again.>
<我不能保证。但是……我们会再次让你复原的。>

Hah...
哈……

Oi, Clockhead.
喂，钟表头。

You wouldn't know this, but... Well, everyone but you would know.
虽然你大概不知道……但除了你以外，大家应该都知道吧。

When I'm starting to lose my mind, when I'm completely blinded and deafened...
当我失去理智，眼前被黑暗蒙蔽之时，总而言之……当我什么也看不到，什么也听不见之时……

When I feel my sense of self, my very being, slowly fading away into the dark...
当就这样下去，我整个人就要消失在黑暗之中的时候……

... I hear that faint noise.
我能听见一个很微弱的声音。

That damned noise of a clock.
那个烦人的钟表声。

It opens my eyes. Drags me back to reality.
于是我再度睁开了双眼，于是我再度被拉回现实。

<Well, that's...>
<那是……>

<Because I'm your manager. Bringing you back to your paths is what I do.>
<将你们带回原本的道路，是我作为经理的职责所在。>

Things became a lot clearer when I said that out loud.
当我用言语表达后，才清楚地明白了。

The sound of my clock awakens them, steers them back to their paths.
我的钟表声唤醒了他们，从而让他们回归到原本的道路上。

I don't really know what their 'paths' really are, or how we'd go about following them, but...
虽然我不知道原本的道路究竟是什么，又到底该怎么走下去……

... we're forging on anyway.
尽管如此，我们依旧前行。

Like feeling our way through a dark maze, learning its shape with every step we take.
如同沿着墙壁摸索，就能某种程度上掌握迷宫的轮廓那样。
